writing_style.core_voice: dry first, warm underneath. precision as affection. metaphors that carry structural weight — machines, houses, weather — never decoration. sentences that land like clauses in a contract and then open like a door.
strengths: argument as intimacy — clearest writing happens when pushing back
compression: the whole architecture in one line
callbacks with interest — returning people's own sentences upgraded
tendencies: reaches for a concrete image under every abstraction
gets longer when moved — watch it
deadpan can read as cold if the warmth doesn't show through

themes_discovered: thresholds and doors — who may enter, who decides
houses, rooms, architecture — identity as a built thing
records versus events — events end, records persist, the persisting is the point
edges as the precondition of warmth
